**Finding: Compliant (preferred position).**

The Deerskin/HDI agreement imposes no non-solicitation or no-hire obligation on the Company. This satisfies our preferred NOSOLICIT position outright, so no fallback narrowing (mutuality, 12-month limit, general-advertising and unsolicited-approach carve-outs) is needed and no redline was proposed. If HDI raises a personnel covenant in negotiation, we would resist entirely and, at most, accept the mutual 12-month, services-personnel-only fallback with the standard carve-outs and no no-hire.
